summary: The base lets a late prefill allocation RuntimeError escape. The exact candidate converts KV allocation misses to a typed exception, rolls back newly allocated request slots, restores scheduler ownership, and permits an empty scheduler to retry; focused and independent boundary tests passed.

tests.what_was_measured: On recorded base, an injected post-admission allocation RuntimeError escaped the real Scheduler._get_new_batch_prefill_raw call.
At exact candidate commit: 39 tests and 12 subtests passed, covering typed allocation failure, request-slot rollback, requeue/retry, chunk ownership, backpressure, and admission boundaries.
Independent transient-OOM retry succeeds without duplicate ownership, and unrelated RuntimeError remains uncaught.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 was visible via ROCm 7.2, but the issue-specific deterministic control-flow tests executed on CPU.

remaining_limitations: The reported eight-NVIDIA-B300 TP8/DCP4 Kimi-K3 workload and weights were unavailable.
CUDA/B300, distributed, sustained-traffic, and model-semantic behavior remain unverified.
No native source changed; a native rebuild was not applicable.
